title: Closed a tab by mistake? Bring it back #shorts
description:
In Chrome, Edge and Firefox, Ctrl + Shift + T reopens the tab you just closed. Press it again to keep going back. On a Mac it's Cmd + Shift + T.

#techtips #chrome #pctips #productivity #shorts

points.d: your last closed tab comes right back.
it keeps reopening older closed tabs.

fix:
Press Ctrl + Shift + T
to undo a closed tab
fix_sub: Works in Chrome, Edge and Firefox.
question: Did you know this shortcut? Yes or No in the comments
